moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-eva-mincho-card, written here): 24 fps hard cuts, no easing; serif 900, white on black. Frames 0–5 blank; 6–11: first half of the text, 120 px, scaleX 0.62, centred; 12–15: second half, 54 px, scaleX 0.7, low right, ≤ 2 lines; 16–23: L layout: head 64 px scaleX 0.72 top-left + the last chars as a vertical column at the right (scaleX 0.78); 24–61: final card: first word 34 px scaleX 0.72 top-left over the rest at 66 px scaleX 0.66, centred; 62–71 blank. Loop 3 s. Params: nhịp cắt (6 / 4 / 8 / 38 khung ở 24 fps) · nén ngang (0.62–0.78) · kiểu chữ (serif 900). Hard cuts, no easing; only the last card stays long enough to read. Serif 900, condensed with scaleX 0.62–0.78.
